ItemID: NA; Title: ecozy LD200B Robot Vacuum and Mop Cleaner with LiDAR Navigation, 3500Pa Suction, Large Individual Dustbin and Water Tank, Compatible with Alexa, Multi-Floor Mapping, Ideal for Pet Hair (Blue); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am focused on workshop projects and repair supplies right now, with no current need for a robot vacuum.

ItemID: NA; Title: KRAKEN BOND Wow! Super Crazy Glue Clear - Strong Cyanoacrylate (CA) Glue for Plastic, Metal, Wood, PVC, Fast Curing Epoxy Adhesive | 3 Pack, 3.5 Oz.; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Quick repair adhesive fits my projects, but I would choose the glue with activator on this page first.
ItemID: NA; Title: BOCEUC Multimeter Test Leads, Meter Needle Test Probe Adapter Set, Aligator Clips Electronic Test Lead kit Accessories(10 PCS); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The clips look useful for troubleshooting, but I would need to confirm compatibility with my equipment before choosing them.
ItemID: NA; Title: Adhesive Guru CA Glue with Activator Woodworking (3.5 oz - 13,5 fl oz) Ca Glue for Woodworking, Cyanoacrylate Glue and Activator (1 Pack); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for quickly securing small pieces during assembly, complementing my screws and mounting tapes.
ItemID: NA; Title: TRYMAG Small Strong Magnets, Rare Earth Magnets, 3 Size 75pcs, Small Neodymium Magnets Black Fridge Magnets for Whiteboard, Billboard, Hobbies, Office, Round Button Magnets; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The size assortment interests me for projects, but I would try the larger disc magnets first rather than buy both packs.
ItemID: NA; Title: FlashFix | Super Glue Plus | Industrial Strength Welding Glue & Powder for Filling Gaps | Instant Cure Adhesive for Plastic, Metal, Rubber & More | Heavy Duty Repair on Cars, Boats, & DIY Projects; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try the glue-and-powder system for filling gaps in broken parts where tape or bolts would be awkward.
ItemID: NA; Title: PRUVADE Sterilization Pouches - 200 Pack 2.75” x 10” Sterilizer Bags for Dental Offices - Autoclave Self Sealing Sterilization Pouch for Dental Instruments, Nail Techs, Tattoo, Medical Lab-2.75” x 10”; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent projects do not involve sterilizing instruments, so these would not serve a current need.
ItemID: NA; Title: Specialty Resin & Chemical General Purpose Clear Epoxy Resin 2 Gal | Clear 2-Part Epoxy Resin Kit for Tabletops, Countertops, Encapsulation, & More | Self-Leveling, Water Resistant, Impact Resistant; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: This fits my previous resin work, but I would wait until I have a project requiring another two gallons.
